Which shortwave stations broadcast in Portuguese?

In the A-26 schedule, 24 stations broadcast in Portuguese. The most heavily scheduled include China Radio International, Radio Vaticana, Rádio Nacional Amazônia, Radio Habana Cuba.

What frequencies are used for shortwave broadcasts in Portuguese?

The most-used frequencies are 15565, 6180, 11760, 11780, 4915 kHz. Which one is best depends on the time of day, the season and your location.

How can I listen without a shortwave radio?

Use a free WebSDR or KiwiSDR receiver in your browser. Our Listen Online page links to receivers and explains how to tune. Schedules are in UTC, so convert to your local time first.
